svg.title: The sandbox's layers, from the outside in: a systemd scope, prlimit, bubblewrap and a seccomp filter around the generated code.
svg.desc: The outermost layer is a systemd user scope, a cgroup that caps memory, tasks and CPU. Inside it, prlimit caps file size and open files and turns off core dumps. Inside that, bubblewrap gives an empty environment, no network, no capabilities and only read-only mounts, apart from /out, /tmp and /dev/shm, which are sized in-memory file systems. Inside that, a seccomp filter denies system calls such as io_uring, bpf and the keyring calls. At the centre, the generated code runs under a fixed launcher, which kills every other process when the code ends. The host then copies out only a JSON result and up to four checked PNG figures.

g.text: file size, open files, no core
no network, empty env, no caps
